events.n: [1] According to Alfred Robaut, _L'oeuvre de Corot_, Paris, 1905: III:26, no. 1313, the NGA painting was offered for sale by Corot to Mme. Isbert, a miniaturist.
events.q: Given by the artist to Mme Camille Cornelie Isbert [1825-1911], Paris.

events.n: [2] According to Robaut 1905 (see no. 1), and Chester Dale papers in NGA curatorial records, the painting was lent by Tesse to an exhibition in Lille 1881.
events.q: Paul Tesse, Paris, by 1881.

events.t: L'Oeuvre de Corot. Catalogue raisonné et illustré
events.pg: 3:no. 1313, as _Fontainebleau, rocher dans l'ombre sous la feuille_
events.q: Robaut, Alfred, and Etienne Moreau-Nélaton. _L'Oeuvre de Corot. Catalogue raisonné et illustré_. 5 vols. Paris, 1905: 3:no. 1313, as _Fontainebleau, rocher dans l'ombre sous la feuille_.

events.n: [3] The painting was not, however, in the sale of the Robaut collection, Paris, Hôtel Drouot, 28 November 1919, which included another, considerably smaller (23 x 31.5 cm) sketch, no. 6, _Dans la forêt de Fontainebleau_.
